global.name: Global Event
global.tip:
Newly registered global event is appended to the existing event list
It overwrites any previously registered event with the same key and stops the currently running instance of that event

actor.name: Actor Event
actor.tip:
Newly registered actor event overwrites the existing event of the same type
It also stops the currently running instance of that event
Overridden events can still be triggered using the 'Call Event' command

element.name: Element Event
element.tip:
Newly registered element event overwrites the existing event of the same type
It also stops the currently running instance of that event
Overridden events can still be triggered using the 'Call Event' command

registerEvent-operation.label: Operation
registerEvent-operation.tip: Choose whether to register or unload the event

register.name: Register
register.tip: Package the commands in the block below into a temporary event and add it to the object

unregister.name: Unregister
unregister.tip: After unloading the registered event, it will no longer trigger and will stop execution

reset.name: Reset
reset.tip: Unload all registered events and stop any currently executing tasks

registerEvent-type.label: Event
registerEvent-type.tip: Choose the event type for the object

registerEvent-priority.label: Priority
registerEvent-priority.tip: Trigger before element events, unaffected by "Pause Game" and "Prevent Scene Input" commands

registerEvent-namespace.label: Namespace
registerEvent-namespace.tip:
Enable: use an independent variable scope
Disable: share variable scope with the current event

registerEvent-tag.label: Tag
registerEvent-tag.tip: A label for unloading this event later
